text:
sara_lee: Quick heads up — planning to flip the precision flag for sherpa model to int8 for 10% of traffic tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need preflight ok from infra/QA.

devon_kim: timeline noted. Is this on dedicated or hosted?

sara_lee: hosted first. We'll roll on canary pool A (us-west-2) only. Dedicated later pending results.

maria_gonzalez: I'll run the perf and regression hooks tonight. Can you drop the exact flag name and the rollout ID?

sara_lee: flag: features.sherpa.precision=INT8_AUDIT, rollout_id: r-2026-03-int8-a. Config snippet:
```yaml
rollout_id: r-2026-03-int8-a
traffic_percent: 10
regions: [us-west-2]
precision_profile: int8_default
guardrails:
  latency_max_p95_ms: 350
  quality_drop_threshold_pct: 0.8
```

aj: perf note — int8_default has known tail latency blips on sequence lengths > 1k. Can we limit to seq<=512 for the canary?

sara_lee: good call. updating config to add max_seq: 512. New snippet: 
```yaml
max_sequence_length: 512
```

devon_kim: infra checklist: 
- confirm model binary built with quant kernels for int8
- autoscale policy adjusted for canary burst
- canary A/V toggles ready

canary-bot: scheduled rollout r-2026-03-int8-a 
- start: 2026-03-12T16:00:00Z
- traffic: 10%
- region: us-west-2

maria_gonzalez: started regression evals against the core eval set. ETA ~2h. I'll post results here.

aj: also please add a quick smoke check to the CI job: 
`curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/serve/sherpa/predict -d '{"input":"the quick brown fox"}'`
We should verify tokens match previous baseline.

qa-bot: preflight checks queued (run-3345). Tests: perf_basic, nlg_bleu_smoke, canary_metrics.

sara_lee: thanks all. If perf/regression OK, I'll flip at the window. If any guardrail breaches, auto-rollback should trigger. Ping me for manual hold. :pray:

devon_kim: noted. I'll keep an eye on autoscale. Ping me if we need more headroom.

maria_gonzalez: reg evals done: small drop in BLEU (~0.6%) and latency improved p95 ~15ms. No regressions beyond threshold. Attaching quick summary below.

maria_gonzalez: summary: 
- BLEU baseline: 28.3 -> int8: 27.7 (delta -0.6)
- quality_drop_threshold_pct: 0.8% (so we're within)
- p95 latency baseline: 320ms -> int8: 305ms

aj: that looks acceptable. Confirming max_seq cap in place?

sara_lee: yes, max_sequence_length: 512 applied.

canary-bot: rollout started (r-2026-03-int8-a) at 2026-03-12T16:00:05Z. Monitoring metrics channel: #canary-alerts.

devon_kim: seeing a small error spike for a subset of requests (rate 0.2% -> 0.6%). Investigating whether it's timeouts from downstream logging.

maria_gonzalez: holding on final sign-off until errors stabilise. If it keeps rising, abort.

sara_lee: agreed. canary-bot, please auto-pause if error_rate > 1% for 5m.

canary-bot: configured auto-pause rule for r-2026-03-int8-a.

qa-bot: additional note — some long-form prompts (>600 tokens) may still leak through clients that don't set max_seq. We've added a middleware cap but recommend a quick client-side guard too.

aj: thanks. I'll open a small PR to add server-side enforcement as a fallback.

sara_lee: perfect. We'll reconvene in #eng-ml post-mortem if anything odd. Otherwise, plan to expand to 30% next week. :rocket:
